data_fields.donor_constant: The Mines 40/40/10/10 (rat/skeleton/spider/troll); other zones as listed in the note

data_fields.donor_constant: level >= 2 for spider and troll bands in The Mines, else skeleton

data_fields.name: nested_draw_ruins
data_fields.donor_constant: second roll rand(10) > 0 selects bugbear (0.9), else vampire (0.1)

data_fields.name: custom_curve_off_after_empty
data_fields.donor_constant: custom curve switched off for the rest of the map build after one empty roll

best_idea: Keep each zone's spawn table as data (a roll modulus and bands of roll ranges), gate a band by substituting a lower-tier monster below a level rather than re-rolling, and let a custom curve override the base roll only until its first empty result on a level.
decision_why: The band table as zone data with a substitution gate fits parity row 23 (zone population). Reject the name-prefix zone lookup and the hard-coded switch statements. Keep the custom override only as explicit per-level state that resets at each level build. Caps, respawn and despawn are not in this donor's code.
acceptance: A server test with the Mines table asserts that over 10,000 spawn rolls, skeletons are 60 percent plus or minus 1 at level 1 and spiders and trolls are each 10 percent plus or minus 1 at level 2; a custom curve that returns nothing once is not consulted again on that level.
